decision: Bi-encoder: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (best dense retriever on validation in both scopes). Cross-encoder: cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 over the BM25 top 50, kept as the pre-specified neural reranker although it trails BM25 here. BAAI/bge-reranker-base was started and abandoned for CPU cost before producing a result.
note: Development figures used to fix the blind-run configuration. They are not the blind result.
